title: Ipv6Header and UdpHeader missing PartialEq derive
description:
File: rust/lichen-ipv6/src/lib.rs
Lines: 302, 413

Issue: Ipv6Header and UdpHeader derive Debug, Clone, Copy but not PartialEq, Eq. This makes testing awkward and prevents use in collections.

Fix: Add PartialEq, Eq to both structs.
